title: Taylor's One Best Way Explained Simply | Principles of Management Ep 8
description:
Is there one best way to do a job? At Chai Corner, six people make chai six different ways, and one cup takes two minutes while another takes five. In this animated lesson we use Ravi's chai stall to understand F.W. Taylor's scientific management in the simplest way possible.

You will meet Frederick Winslow Taylor, the father of scientific management, and his 1911 book The Principles of Scientific Management. We look at his famous shovel study at Bethlehem Steel, a time and motion study at Chai Corner, his four principles (science not rule of thumb, harmony not discord, cooperation not individualism, and development of every worker), his techniques (standardisation, scientific selection and training, differential piece rate and functional foremanship), and the big criticism: it treated workers like machines.

This is Episode 8 of our Principles of Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
